ana: Noticed p99 spike on A100 for flash_paged_fused when rotary_scale != 1.0 during nightly perf. seq=2048, batch 12.

jon: can you paste the repro and profile?

ana: repro:
```
python perf/run_attention.py --attn=flash_paged_fused --rotary_scale=0.65 --seq_len=2048 --batch=12 --dtype=fp16
```
profile top kernels:
```
40.1% fused_flash_attention_kernel
28.3% page_cache_copy
11.5% kv_cache_eviction
```

lucas: page_cache_copy + kv_cache_eviction indicates we fell out of fused path. selector log?

ana: selector:
```
[selector] cand=flash_paged_fused ok=true rotary_exact=false
[selector] cand=flash_paged_fallback ok=true chosen=true
```
so exact-match on rotary prevented fused being chosen.

priya: I remember we later added per-dim scaling to fused kernel but never updated selector rules. two fixes: relax selector (or add metadata flag rotary_agnostic=true) and include rotary_scale in batching key so we don't mix requests.

jon: adding rotary_scale to batch-key is important. also normalize floats (e.g., round to 2 decimal places) to avoid cardinality explosion.

ana: CI branch ml/rotary-relax pushed with selector change + batch-key normalization + unit test + perf microbench.

dev-bench-bot: perf artifact uploaded s3://redwood-perf/199001/rotary-relax/summary.zip

lucas: quick synthetic results:
Before: p99=138ms evictions=3120
After: p99=105ms evictions=16

priya: huge drop. confirms fused path restored and paging thrash avoided.

jon: small follow-up: dynamic paging page_size <=32KB amplifies eviction noise when kernels flip. recommend Optimize suggest page_size >=64KB for workloads with paged KV and fused kernels.

ana: added ticket to Optimize and included replay charts: https://perf/reports/199001/rotary-relax

ci-bot: CI passed for ml/rotary-relax (7/7).

ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy for branch ml/rotary-relax.

lucas: note for rollout: emit telemetry metric `chosen_kernel` and `rotary_scale_normalized` to correlate evictions -> kernel variant in prod. also add perf regression test in nightly suite for rot_scale=0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0.

ana: will include telemetry and tests in PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
